messages.author: 71df1ea0682dcc02
messages.subject: Re: updating SPAdes
parts:
This is the user group for the R package SpaDES, which is currently version 2.0.4 on CRAN (https://cran.r-project.org/package=SpaDES).

update.packages() should take care of updates, or you can install the latest version directly using install.packages("SpaDES").

Though I suspect you are talking about a different piece of software, in which case we can't help. Sorry!
